# automox_scheduled_window (Resource)

A maintenance exclusion window: a period during which Automox will not patch the server groups it covers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A maintenance window is an exclusion: it prevents patching during the period
# it covers. window_type is always "exclude"; Automox accepts no other value.

resource "automox_scheduled_window" "holiday_freeze" {
  window_name        = "Holiday Change Freeze"
  window_description = "No patching over the holiday period"

  recurrence = "RECURRING"
  dtstart    = "2026-12-20T00:00:00Z"
  rrule      = "FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=12;BYDAY=+3MO"

  # Permitted on a RECURRING window; rejected on a ONCE window, where Automox
  # derives the duration itself.
  duration_minutes = 10080

  # Windows identify groups by UUID, where every other endpoint uses integer
  # IDs. automox_server_group exposes both.
  group_uuids = [automox_server_group.workstations.uuid]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dtstart` (String) When the window starts, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `recurrence` (String) `ONCE` for a single window, or `RECURRING` for one that repeats annually. This determines which `rrule` forms are legal and whether `duration_minutes` may be set.
- `rrule` (String) Recurrence rule. Automox accepts only a narrow subset of RFC 5545:

- With `recurrence = "ONCE"`: `FREQ=DAILY;UNTIL=<YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ>`. `COUNT` and `INTERVAL` are rejected.
- With `recurrence = "RECURRING"`: `FREQ=YEARLY` with `BYMONTH` and `BYDAY`, where `BYDAY` may carry an ordinal such as `+2TU`.

Example: `FREQ=YEARLY;BYMONTH=1;BYDAY=+1MO` for the first Monday of January.
- `window_description` (String) Description, up to 500 characters. Automox requires this.
- `window_name` (String) Window name, up to 100 characters.

### Optional

- `duration_minutes` (Number) How long the window lasts, in minutes.

**Only valid with `recurrence = "RECURRING"`.** For a `ONCE` window Automox derives the duration from `dtstart` to the `UNTIL` in the rule, and rejects the request if this is supplied.
- `group_uuids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the server groups this window covers. Use the `uuid` attribute of an `automox_server_group`, not its `id` — this endpoint is one of the few that identifies groups by UUID.

An empty set means the window covers nothing and has no effect.
- `status` (String) `active` or `inactive`. New windows are active.
- `window_type` (String) Window kind. `exclude` is the only value Automox accepts, and is the default.

Automox's own published example uses `exclusion`, which the API rejects.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `org_uuid` (String) Organization UUID the window belongs to, resolved from the provider's `organization_id`.
- `updated_at` (String)
- `window_uuid` (String) Window UUID, and the resource identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Maintenance windows import by their UUID. Automox issues no integer ID for a
# window, so there is no numeric identifier to use here.
terraform import automox_scheduled_window.holiday_freeze 4486704d-d81e-41ac-afff-037665881679
```
